description: This file defines the LauncherViewModel class which manages the 'What’s New' feature for the launcher screen in an Android app. It loads a YAML file to determine the latest updates and interacts with preferences to show or hide update notifications.

classes.name: LauncherViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing the display logic for 'What's New' updates based on YAML data and user preferences.

methods.name: whatsNewToShow
methods.description: Returns a flow indicating the latest 'Whats New' item to show, based on last shown ID and update data.

methods.name: setLatestWhatsNewId
methods.description: Updates the stored preference to the latest 'Whats New' ID after showing updates.
